Scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Conjunction): 神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃：因为神农想帮别人，所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃，Use “因为……所以……” to make the cause-and-effect relationship explicit: his wish to help others causes his desire to learn about the plants. [rule: none]
Run 2: (nothing flagged here)
Run 3: 别人：人们，The word refers to “other people” in contrast with a particular person already under discussion; here Shennong wants to help people in general. [teacher rule: bieren]

output.reason: Run 1 changes the causal conjunction, Run 3 corrects 别人 to 人们, and Run 2 flags nothing.
